items.title: Exploitation of Citrix NetScaler Zero-Day Hits Appliances Patched Days Earlier
items.summary: Citrix has confirmed that a new zero-day vulnerability, CVE-2026-88779, emerged just days after two other exploited flaws were patched. The post Exploitation of Citrix NetScaler Zero-Day Hits Appliances Patched Days Earlier appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: Citrix NetScaler 零日漏洞攻擊波及數日前才修補的設備
items.summary_zh: Citrix 已證實，在修補了另外兩個遭利用的漏洞僅數天後，又出現了一個新的零日漏洞 CVE-2026-88779。《Exploitation of Citrix NetScaler Zero-Day Hits Appliances Patched Days Earlier》首先發表於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Citrix patches NetScaler SAML zero-day exploited in attacks
items.summary: Citrix has released emergency updates for a new NetScaler denial-of-service vulnerability tracked as CVE-2026-88779 that has been exploited in zero-day attacks, with researchers investigating whether it can also be exploited for remote code execution. [...]
items.title_zh: Citrix 修補已遭攻擊利用的 NetScaler SAML 零日漏洞
items.summary_zh: Citrix 已針對編號為 CVE-2026-88779 的新 NetScaler 阻斷服務漏洞釋出緊急更新，該漏洞已在零日攻擊中遭到利用。研究人員目前正在調查其是否亦可用於遠端執行程式碼。[...]
